---
title: Notes taken while the scan was running, and never finished afterwards
---

Started during the scan and put down again; nobody ever wrote a day on this one, which is the whole reason it is here.

The one line it did finish is the address the scan was reading when it stopped, written out whole because an address has nowhere to break: <https://example.invalid/scan?stoppedAt=TheNoteTheScanWasReadingWhenEverythingHereWasPutDownAndNeverPickedUpAgain>
